specs.title: CB-01 input has role combobox
CB-02 listbox has role listbox
CB-03 input has aria-controls refering to listbox
CB-04 button has accessible name
CB-04-B button has tabindex -1
CB-04-C button has aria-controls = listbox
CB-05 options have a role of option
CB-06 input has aria-expanded false on init
CB-07 button click changes aria-expanded to true
CB-08 button click with open listbox changes aria-expanded to false
CB-09 typing in input opens listbox
CB-10 Esc closes listbox (without clearing input)
CB-11 Escape clears input if pressed on closed listbox)
CB-12 arrow down opens listbox and sets active on first option
CB-13 arrow keys can cycle through the elements
CB-13 arrow keys can wrap listbox
CB-14 Alt+DownArrow opens textbox, but does not move focus
CB-15 focus stays on input during arrow key navigation
CB-16 Enter selects the active option, passes value to input and closes listbox
CB-17 click selects target option, passes value to input and closes listbox
CB-18 active option has aria selected = true
CB-19 filtering shows only matching options
CB-20 ArrowDown selects first option after filterning
CB-21 listbox closes if there are no matches
CB-22 combobox uses the list type of autocomplete
CB-23 The combobox uses manual selection
CB-STATIC Static test on combobox
CB-STATIC Static test on combobox with open listbox
